blocks.text: A Sass function calculates one value and returns it. A mixin writes a group of declarations instead.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `@return` gives back one calculated value from a Sass function. That value can be used in a CSS declaration.

blocks.text: The card padding becomes 12px. The return value fits where an ordinary CSS value would go.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A function needs @return. Use a mixin when you want to output several properties.
